test_masked_multistream_model: test the MaskedSequential model with PositionalEncoding, TransposeMultiheadAttention, and MaskedTemporalPooling layers
test_masked_temporal_pooling: test MaskedTemporalPooling with max, avg, and sum pooling methods on masked sequences
test_transpose_multihead_attention: test TransposeMultiheadAttention with masked input tensors and multiple attention heads
